mentions.name: PicPickr
mentions.description: This app helps users select, sort, and cull photos more easily on desktop. It was built to scratch the author's own itch of solving this problem while learning and tinkering.
mentions.problem: Selecting, sorting, and culling photos on desktop is tedious; the app was born from the author's own need to solve this problem.
